policy: Junia of Romans 16:7 is a woman, and the page says the texts differ.
source: Essenthos, on the project owner's ruling of 2026-11-01 that Junia of Romans 16:7 is a woman and that the texts differ

says.name: Junia
says.notes: The texts differ on this name (ROM 16:7): Nestle 1904, the SBL Greek New Testament and the King James print the feminine, Junia; Tischendorf, Luther 1912 and the American Standard Version the masculine, Junias; the editions printed without accents can be read either way.

rulings.why: 'Salute Andronicus and Junia' (ROM 16:7): the owner's word on 2026-11-01. Nestle prints the feminine Ἰουνίαν, Tischendorf the masculine Ἰουνιᾶν; the record was headed by the dataset's masculine.
